provenance.l: Blue Moon Mk1 has not flown (NET Q1 2027). The record gives only: cargo lander, BE-7, Shackleton connecting ridge. The entry state, mass, propellant, descent rate and the site (-84, 20; not the ridge) are drawn estimates, not sourced figures
Blue Moon Mk1 lunar lander overview — Blue Origin

Blue Moon Pathfinder Mission 1 — still unflown as of Nov 2026, launch NET Q1 2027; target Shackleton Connecting Ridge near the south pole, landing within 100 m, one BE-7 (Wikipedia). No descent timeline, touchdown speed or hover is published
